headlines.title: Marvell Agreed to Pay $1,132 a Share for Lumentum. The Stock Trades Near $510. Here's Why It’s Not as Good As It Looks.
headlines.summary: The gap between Lumentum's stock price and Marvell's offer looks like easy money. It isn't.

headlines.title: Lumentum Sinks 15% as AI Chip Selloff Deepens
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell 15% today as the AI selloff deepened. Marvell is paying for Lumentum in stock with no price protection, so Lumentum trades on Marvell’s shares.

headlines.title: Applied Optoelectronics Sinks 16%, Coherent Tumbles 14% Despite Strong Outlook, Lumentum Plunges 13% as AI Optical Stocks Slide
headlines.summary: Record revenue, raised guidance, and capacity sold out through 2027 couldn't save the optical group from a brutal two-day rout. One election result has traders dumping the whole supply chain, and the next catalysts could decide who recovers first.

headlines.title: Marvell agrees to buy Lumentum in $115B stock deal
headlines.summary: The deal brings together "complementary electrical and optical technologies" needed for connectivity in artificial intelligence infrastructure, Marvell said in a news release.

headlines.title: Marvell Stock Eyes 35% Upside After Lumentum Deal
headlines.summary: Marvell's stock has collapsed nearly 30% in a month while its own guidance keeps climbing, and the gap between those two lines is exactly where our model's price target lives.

description: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers component products, including semiconductor laser chips, laser sub-assemblies, line subsystems, and wavelength management systems. The company also offers system products, such as optical modules, optical circuit switches, and industrial lasers, including short-pulse solid-state lasers and kilowatt-class fiber lasers. Its products and solutions are used in cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), telecommunications, consumer, and industrial end-market applications. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
